title: Phase 0 — static runtime, everything frozen
description: The real viewer mounted offline from a hand-written manifest: card, Plotly figure, MultiSelect and text component, all served from frozen payloads with tier badges. No backend, no network.

title: Penguins fully LIVE — cards, filters, figures, table, advanced viz (phases 1+3+4+5+6)
description: Built by producer B from a spec + local Parquet (depictio dashboard build-static). All 10 components are live, none frozen: change the species or year selection and the cards recompute, the scatter re-renders (bind-and-refill), the live table re-filters, the sunburst and dot plot reload their frames through the in-browser port of the advanced-viz sampling policy — and the CODE-MODE bar chart re-derives itself, replaying its Python prologue (group_by + sort, transpiled to a JSON IR) over the filtered rows before refilling. Header-click sorting and pagination included, all computed offline through the in-browser hyparquet engine with server-exact Polars semantics. Regenerate with depictio/serverless/examples/generate_demo_manifest.py.
